deployments_detail.use: United Tractors and subsidiary Pamapersada Nusantara (PAMA) partnered with Microsoft to build a digital inventory-planning product using predictive maintenance on Azure (SAP HANA on Azure, Azure Kubernetes Services, Azure SQL) to forecast heavy-equipment repairs/spare-part needs and support smart mining. [Microsoft Azure]
Fiona - AI-based consumer service application from subsidiary FIFGROUP (won digital product awards)

TARRA (Toyota Interactive Virtual Assistant) by PT Toyota-Astra Motor: AI chatbot with voice-command capability across LINE, WhatsApp, Facebook Messenger, website and the mTOYOTA app, answering product, service-booking, dealer, promo and credit-simulation queries 24/7. [none]
deployments_detail.value: More than 1.2 million interactions since March 2019

deployments_detail.use: TASIA (Toyota Astra Intelligent Assistant) by Auto2000 (Astra's Toyota dealer network): NLP/ML-powered automotive chatbot on web and WhatsApp handling purchase info, credit simulation, service booking, status tracking and dealer locator, positioned as Indonesia's first automotive chatbot. [Suitmedia]

FIONA (FIFGROUP Intelligence Personal Assistant): AI-based virtual contact center at FIFGROUP (Astra's consumer-finance arm) providing 24-hour customer support on contract info, BPKB document retrieval and vehicle registration renewals; won 2023 Indonesia digital product awards. [none]
Group flags rising AI-powered cyberattacks; Chief of Group Digital Strategy discusses AI defense posture
Garda Oto (Asuransi Astra) uses AI to detect fraudulent vehicle-insurance claims by analyzing unusual data patterns during claims processing. [none]

Garxia (Garda eXperience Intelligent Assistant), an AI virtual assistant chatbot in the Garda Mobile Otocare app that lets customers simulate premiums and buy Garda Oto motor insurance end-to-end via chat; marketed as Indonesia's first insurance-purchase chatbot. [none]

Robotic Process Automation (UiPath) at Astra Credit Companies (ACC) automating the admin-subsidy process in the AOL financing system for the multiguna (multipurpose) brand division, replacing manual repetitive work. [UiPath]

PT Astra Graphia Information Technology (AGIT) partnered with HPE and Equinix to deliver AI-based private cloud solutions (consulting, system design, infrastructure-as-a-service, managed services) for AI workloads to Indonesian enterprises; MoU signed July 2025. [HPE, Equinix]
